welcome.title: See how internet data actually travels — step by step
welcome.subtitle: Start right here in Simple Mode. Switch to Pro anytime for hex byte dumps, CLI terminals, and fault testing.
welcome.step1Body: Choose a starter protocol below or open the full library of 39 protocols.
welcome.step2Body: Watch packets move between devices and read plain-English notes at each step.
welcome.step3Body: Tap a moving packet or step to inspect headers, ports, and real-world security tips.
welcome.studioCaption: Live packet framing, routing tables, and discrete-event playback
welcome.step4Body: Wire routers, switches, and firewalls across 20 guided labs and CLI shells.
welcome.capabilitiesTitle: Every layer from physical copper to TLS handshakes, interactive in one studio
welcome.simCardBody: Wire hosts, L3 routers, VLAN switches, and stateful firewalls. Run ping, traceroute, dig, or curl, watch live throughput charts, and step event-by-event.
welcome.inspectorCardBody: Dissect Ethernet, IP, TCP, and TLS headers byte by byte, filter captures with Wireshark expressions, and simulate packet loss or expired certificates.
welcome.masteryCardBody: Reinforce concepts with protocol quizzes, port matching games, OSI challenges, and a live CIDR subnet calculator.

modals.tour1Body: Open Protocols in the top-left anytime to browse Core, Application, and Security protocols, jump to any step, or star favorites.
modals.tour2Body: Use Simple mode for clear animations and plain-English explanations, or switch to Pro anytime for hex byte dumps, CLI terminals, and link faults.
modals.tour3Body: Click any packet to inspect its headers and layers. In Pro mode, filter frames with Wireshark expressions or export a real .pcap file.
modals.tour4Body: Switch to Simulator mode to wire routers, switches, firewalls, and servers across 20 guided labs and run real ping, traceroute, dig, and curl commands.
